top_signals.title: Citigroup Raises $12 Billion in Its Biggest-Ever Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc. raised $12 billion in its largest-ever US dollar bond sale, seizing a chance to sell debt as credit markets rallied a day after the Federal Reserve hiked rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Generac Surges 18% on $8 Billion Amazon Data Center Deal | Closing Bell
top_signals.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Isabelle Lee, Lisa Mateo, and Alexis Christoforous. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Munis Are Near Cheapest Levels in a Year
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Aashna Shah joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US state and local government bonds are near their cheapest levels relative to Treasuries in a year as heavy issuance and fading demand collide with a broader fixed-income selloff.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
